title: Listen and choose 1.4
role: Events coordinator informing a client about a change of plans
can_do: I can talk about future plans with going to, will and the present continuous.
I can apologize for a change with the present perfect.

items.prompt: Why can't the speaker join the tour?

options.text: She is going to the airport
She is having dinner with a client

items.explanation: The speaker says: having dinner with a client.
The speaker says: we have postponed the concert until next Thursday.

items.prompt: What will the second speaker do?
items.explanation: The speaker says: I will send you the address.
